note: Images outside "retained" and "additionalCaptures" were captured in one scripted run from the public Editor at siteRevision f98acb6, which pinned every family package at its latest npm version; the site revision was checked before and after the run. No feature-flag queries; no UI text was altered. Sample projects are fictional and built as SB3 files: ネコ/ボール (variable 速さ, messages 開始 and ゲームオーバー, sound ポーン), Ball Demo.sb3 and Ball Demo Plus.sb3 from the tutorial, and the ネコのさんぽ repository (sb3-toolchain import, Git with branch 12-neko-walk, origin kubohiroya/turbowarp-kamishibai-app) handed to the real directory picker through a CDP drop. Projects with extensions are opened with project_url from a routed test host. PR images read public PR #219 without signing in. Headless Chromium does not show the 「…」 debug button or the アドオン palette category.
